name: Art of Republic
sourceName: Short North Alliance — Black owned + led business directory
ownershipDesignations: Black-owned + led directory listing (Short North Alliance)
ownershipEvidence: Short North Alliance includes Art of Republic in its page titled “Black owned + led business directory.” The official Art of Republic Facebook Page identifies the organization as an art gallery and gives the same numbered street address.
notes: The public directory supplies the inclusion context and address; the official Facebook Page provides the customer-facing destination, gallery category, telephone number, and matching address. No claim beyond the publisher’s directory designation is made.

name: Dress for Success Columbus
sourceName: Short North Alliance — Black owned + led business directory
ownershipEvidence: The Short North Alliance directory directly describes Dress for Success Columbus as a “Black-led nonprofit.” Its official website identifies the Columbus organization, public programs, and numbered street location.
notes: The official site states that the organization provides professional attire, career-development tools, and employment-related programs; social destinations are linked from that site. The designation is attributed only to the directory publisher.

name: GFE Trailers
sourceName: Columbus Chamber of Commerce — Designation: Black Owned directory
ownershipEvidence: GFE Trailers appears in the Columbus Chamber’s public directory filtered to “Designation: Black Owned.” Its official website states “Minority Business Enterprise (MBE Certified)” and presents container-rental services for Central Ohio; neither statement is treated as a separate certification verification in this research pass.
notes: The Chamber directory supplies the inclusion designation, Westerville street address, and telephone number. The official site supplies the current customer quote destination, rental-service description, and linked official social accounts.
